quests.hint: The opposite of heavy when you talk about weight.
quests.explanation: 'Light' has several meanings: not heavy, not dark ('a light room') and the noun for a lamp. Here it describes weight.
quests.textToSpeak: This laptop is really ___; it weighs less than a bag of sugar.
quests.correctAnswer: This laptop is really light; it weighs less than a bag of sugar.
quests.contextClue: Weighing less than a bag of sugar is about weight.

quests.hint: The land along the edge of a river.
quests.explanation: 'Bank' also means a place for money. Here it means the sloping land beside a river or lake.
quests.textToSpeak: We had a picnic on the ___ of the river and watched the boats go by.
quests.correctAnswer: We had a picnic on the bank of the river and watched the boats go by.
quests.contextClue: A river is mentioned, not money.

quests.hint: Be the same as or go well with something.
quests.explanation: 'Match' can be a noun ('a football match'), a verb meaning 'go together', or a small stick for fire. Here it is the verb.
quests.textToSpeak: Those two socks don't ___; one is blue and the other is black.
quests.correctAnswer: Those two socks don't match; one is blue and the other is black.
quests.contextClue: Blue and black show that they do not go together.

quests.hint: Treating people equally and reasonably.
quests.explanation: 'Fair' also means light-coloured ('fair hair'), reasonably good ('a fair score') and a noun for an event with rides. Here it means just.
quests.textToSpeak: It's not ___ that I do all the cleaning while you watch TV.
quests.correctAnswer: It's not fair that I do all the cleaning while you watch TV.
quests.contextClue: Unequal work is a complaint about justice.

quests.hint: Intend to say or express.
quests.explanation: 'Mean' can also be an adjective for unkind behaviour ('a mean joke') and a noun for average. Here it is the verb: 'What do you mean?'
quests.textToSpeak: What do you ___ by that? I don't understand what you're saying.
quests.correctAnswer: What do you mean by that? I don't understand what you're saying.
quests.contextClue: Not understanding leads to a request for clarification.

quests.hint: Money paid as a punishment for breaking a rule.
quests.explanation: 'Fine' also means OK ('I'm fine') and thin ('fine hair'). Here it is a noun: money paid as a penalty.
quests.textToSpeak: He had to pay a ___ of fifty euros for parking on a double yellow line.
quests.correctAnswer: He had to pay a fine of fifty euros for parking on a double yellow line.
quests.contextClue: Illegal parking has a financial punishment.

quests.hint: The inside flat part of your hand.
quests.explanation: 'Palm' is also a tree. Here it is the flat inner surface of the hand.
quests.textToSpeak: She held the tiny bird gently in the ___ of her hand.
quests.correctAnswer: She held the tiny bird gently in the palm of her hand.
quests.contextClue: 'Of her hand' shows which part of the body.

quests.hint: The season after winter.
quests.explanation: 'Spring' also means a coiled piece of metal, a source of water, and the verb 'jump suddenly'. Here it is the season.
quests.textToSpeak: We usually go hiking in ___, when the weather is mild and the flowers appear.
quests.correctAnswer: We usually go hiking in spring, when the weather is mild and the flowers appear.
quests.contextClue: Mild weather and new flowers describe a time of year.

quests.hint: Improve the flavour of food by adding spices.
quests.explanation: 'Season' is also a noun for times of the year. As a verb it means add salt, herbs or spices to food.
quests.textToSpeak: Add a little salt and pepper to ___ the soup.
quests.correctAnswer: Add a little salt and pepper to season the soup.
quests.contextClue: Salt and pepper are added to food.

quests.hint: The group of people who make big decisions for a company.
quests.explanation: 'Board' can mean a flat piece of wood ('a chessboard'), a group of directors, or the verb 'get on a plane'. Here it means directors.
quests.textToSpeak: The chairman of the ___ said the company would open two new offices next year.
quests.correctAnswer: The chairman of the board said the company would open two new offices next year.
quests.contextClue: A chairman announcing company plans.

quests.hint: The time that is now.
quests.explanation: 'Present' is also a gift and a verb meaning show ('present a report'). 'At present' means now.
quests.textToSpeak: We don't have any plans to hire more staff at ___.
quests.correctAnswer: We don't have any plans to hire more staff at present.
quests.contextClue: 'Any plans to hire' concerns the current moment.

quests.hint: A person receiving medical care.
quests.explanation: 'Patient' is also an adjective meaning able to wait calmly ('be patient'). Here it is a noun.
quests.textToSpeak: The nurse asked the ___ to wait in the corridor.
quests.correctAnswer: The nurse asked the patient to wait in the corridor.
quests.contextClue: A nurse addresses a person who is ill or receiving care.

quests.hint: A large wild animal with thick fur.
quests.explanation: 'Bear' is also a verb meaning tolerate or carry ('bear the cost'). Here it is the animal.
quests.textToSpeak: We saw a huge brown ___ near the campsite, so we stored our food carefully.
quests.correctAnswer: We saw a huge brown bear near the campsite, so we stored our food carefully.
quests.contextClue: Storing food carefully at a campsite suggests a wild animal.

quests.hint: Attach firmly to a surface.
quests.explanation: 'Stick' can be a noun (a piece of wood) or a verb meaning attach or remain fixed. The past tense is irregular: stuck.
quests.textToSpeak: This tape won't ___ to the wall; it keeps falling off.
quests.correctAnswer: This tape won't stick to the wall; it keeps falling off.
quests.contextClue: Falling off is the opposite of staying attached.

quests.hint: A wooden tool for hitting a ball.
quests.explanation: 'Bat' is also a flying animal. In sport it is the tool used to hit the ball.
quests.textToSpeak: He hit the ball with a wooden ___ and ran to first base.
quests.correctAnswer: He hit the ball with a wooden bat and ran to first base.
quests.contextClue: Hitting a ball and running to a base points to baseball equipment.

quests.hint: Leave a vehicle in a place for a while.
quests.explanation: 'Park' is also a noun for a green public space. As a verb it means to leave a vehicle.
quests.textToSpeak: Where can I ___ the car? All the spaces near the shops are full.
quests.correctAnswer: Where can I park the car? All the spaces near the shops are full.
quests.contextClue: Spaces being full concerns vehicles.

quests.hint: Become less hot.
quests.explanation: 'Cool' is also an informal adjective meaning great ('That's cool!'). Here it is a verb meaning lose heat.
quests.textToSpeak: Let the soup ___ for a few minutes before you eat it; it's too hot.
quests.correctAnswer: Let the soup cool for a few minutes before you eat it; it's too hot.
quests.contextClue: Food that is too hot to eat needs time.

quests.hint: The basin in a kitchen where you wash things.
quests.explanation: 'Sink' is also a verb meaning go under water: 'the boat began to sink'. Here it is the kitchen basin.
quests.textToSpeak: Don't leave dirty plates in the ___; put them in the dishwasher.
quests.correctAnswer: Don't leave dirty plates in the sink; put them in the dishwasher.
quests.contextClue: Dirty plates and a dishwasher point to a kitchen fixture.

quests.hint: Able to cut easily.
quests.explanation: 'Sharp' can describe a blade, a sudden turn ('a sharp bend'), a clear pain or a taste. Here it means capable of cutting well.
quests.textToSpeak: The blade of these scissors is so ___ that it cut through the cardboard easily.
quests.correctAnswer: The blade of these scissors is so sharp that it cut through the cardboard easily.
quests.contextClue: Cutting cardboard easily shows the quality of the blade.

quests.hint: Not calm; with strong waves.
quests.explanation: 'Rough' can describe a surface ('rough hands'), a difficult time or an estimate ('a rough idea'). Here it means stormy, not smooth.
quests.textToSpeak: The sea was very ___ during the ferry crossing, and many passengers felt sick.
quests.correctAnswer: The sea was very rough during the ferry crossing, and many passengers felt sick.
quests.contextClue: Seasickness suggests violent movement.

quests.hint: Free from clouds.
quests.explanation: 'Clear' can mean easy to understand, transparent or free of obstacles. Here it means cloudless.
quests.textToSpeak: The sky was ___ and we could see thousands of stars.
quests.correctAnswer: The sky was clear and we could see thousands of stars.
quests.contextClue: Seeing many stars requires no clouds.

quests.hint: A sea animal with flippers that rests on rocks and beaches.
quests.explanation: 'Seal' is also a verb meaning close tightly ('seal an envelope') and a noun for an official stamp. Here it is the animal.
quests.textToSpeak: We watched a ___ resting on the rocks, then it slid back into the sea.
quests.correctAnswer: We watched a seal resting on the rocks, then it slid back into the sea.
quests.contextClue: Rocks and sea point to a sea creature.

quests.hint: Move your hand from side to side to greet someone.
quests.explanation: 'Wave' is also a noun for a moving line of water. As a verb it means move your hand to say hello or goodbye.
quests.textToSpeak: She smiled and began to ___ at us from the other side of the street.
quests.correctAnswer: She smiled and began to wave at us from the other side of the street.
quests.contextClue: A greeting across a street.

quests.hint: Make the loud sound a dog makes.
quests.explanation: 'Bark' is also the outer covering of a tree. As a verb it describes the sound a dog makes.
quests.textToSpeak: The dog started to ___ as soon as the postman arrived.
quests.correctAnswer: The dog started to bark as soon as the postman arrived.
quests.contextClue: A dog reacting to a visitor.

quests.hint: The steady movement of water in one direction.
quests.explanation: 'Current' is also an adjective meaning happening now ('the current situation') and a flow of electricity.
quests.textToSpeak: The ___ in this river is strong, so swimming here can be dangerous.
quests.correctAnswer: The current in this river is strong, so swimming here can be dangerous.
quests.contextClue: Danger for swimmers suggests moving water.

quests.hint: A collection of data stored on a computer.
quests.explanation: 'File' can be a folder of papers, a tool for smoothing nails, or the verb 'walk in a line'. Here it is a computer document.
quests.textToSpeak: Please save the document as a PDF ___ and send it to me.
quests.correctAnswer: Please save the document as a PDF file and send it to me.
quests.contextClue: PDF and saving refer to digital storage.

quests.hint: Extra money given for good service.
quests.explanation: 'Tip' also means a useful piece of advice or the pointed end of something. Here it is money left for service.
quests.textToSpeak: The waiter was very friendly, so we left him a big ___.
quests.correctAnswer: The waiter was very friendly, so we left him a big tip.
quests.contextClue: Friendly service and leaving something extra.

quests.hint: A line of seats.
quests.explanation: 'Row' (rhymes with 'go') is a line of seats. Another word spelled 'row' (rhymes with 'cow') means an argument. Here it is a line.
quests.textToSpeak: We sat in the front ___ of the cinema, so the screen looked huge.
quests.correctAnswer: We sat in the front row of the cinema, so the screen looked huge.
quests.contextClue: The front position among seats.

quests.hint: Be important.
quests.explanation: 'Matter' is also a noun meaning a subject or problem ('a serious matter'). As a verb, 'it doesn't matter' means it isn't important.
quests.textToSpeak: It doesn't ___ what time you arrive; the shop is open all day.
quests.correctAnswer: It doesn't matter what time you arrive; the shop is open all day.
quests.contextClue: Being open all day removes the importance of timing.

quests.hint: Extra; not currently in use.
quests.explanation: 'Spare' can also mean save someone from something or give time ('spare a minute'). As an adjective it means extra.
quests.textToSpeak: Do you have a ___ pen I could borrow? Mine has run out of ink.
quests.correctAnswer: Do you have a spare pen I could borrow? Mine has run out of ink.
quests.contextClue: A pen without ink means a backup is needed.
